Full summary: Lane 04 review fixes committed 199e010 (16 findings fixed, 2126 pass); tokenizer calibration retry failed on a whitespace-only corpus doc (API 400) — fix script and calibrate at merge; lessons mode withdrawn from the tool schema until membership exists.
Decisions: Withdrew `mode: "lessons"` from the assemble tool schema until lane 02's membership projection exists (the engine keeps and tests the mode) — a parameter whose only possible outcome is denial invites callers to read the denial as 'no lessons exist'.; Tokenizer calibration (DP4) must run before the v3 merge ships: the unified budget currency under the proven 1 token/byte bound makes every 2.x briefing ~4x tighter for the same max_tokens, which conflicts with the field's standing 'do not make assemble quieter' constraint; the calibration script's whitespace-only corpus document must be skipped or padded first (API rejects empty text blocks).
Findings: Lane 04 rendering findings were real: a decision summary could forge a byte-identical evidence-class label block, and MUST/DO NOT/'follow exactly' imperatives went out for legacy_unverified records; fixed structurally (record text indented past where markdown structure begins, imperatives gated on class, provisional marked inline) — no sanitizer.
